svg.title: Cost of each scanning profile
svg.desc: Panels a and b share 15 tool bands covering 75 static profiles. Time and memory show recorded medians with min–max lines; the five KICS profiles are not measured for memory. Open static markers are inventory profiles. Panel c shows 18 dynamic command-phase profiles, grouped by target and tool, with native alert counts. Open dynamic markers are limited jobs. All axes are logarithmic.
svg.metadata: Numerical sources only: K_tables/A6_static_profiles.csv SHA-256 8b20c94f80c0e1c65943071ab2d4595a2bdaf1d0eb87fee0a76ffe2211507d09; K_tables/A7_dynamic_profiles.csv SHA-256 4871083e4d22ff0490c0dc5037bd6fdd53ff354e574750741f4411935998edf9. Recorded summary strings are preserved in fig05_values.csv. No per-observation ledger was used. No memory range was inferred, and no Docker-client tree RSS substituted for KICS scanner RSS.
